The arches, the dresses and the general decoration recall the illuminated pages of the 13th century illuminated books preserved in the Royal Collection and Library.
keywords: Graphic art; Neo-mudejar style; Architecture

de.name: Kath. Pfarrkirche Mariae Geburt, St. Peter und Paul, ehem. Augustinerchorherren-Stiftskirche
description: Überraschenderweise bietet die außen schlichte dreischiffige spätgotische Basilika mit freistehendem Glockenturm im Inneren eine üppige Ausstattung im Rokokostil. Verspielt gestalteter Stuck verteilt sich flächendeckend dicht über Gewölbe und Hochschiffwände. Da dieser von der Schmuzer-Werkstatt etappenweise angebracht wurde, im Chor beginnnend über das Langhaus hinweg bis zur Orgelempore, können deutliche Stilunterschiede erkannt werden: Während der Laub- und Bandwerkdekor des Chorraums noch im späten Régence-Stil gestaltet sind, tritt im Langhaus erstmals die muschelartige Rocaille als neue Ornamentform auf. Matthäus Günthers umfangreicher Freskenzyklus mit Augustinus-Szenen erstreckt sich von Westen nach Osten an den Hochschiffwänden. Das Rundbild der Vierung mit Augustinus in der himmlischen Glorie ersetzt die im Barock dort übliche Kuppel. Die aus dem Rahmen heraustretenden Fresken verbinden das Bild mit den Stukkaturen des Gewölbes und erinnern dadurch an Fresken des Cosmas Damian Asam, dessen Schüler Günther war. Franz Xaver Schmädls pompös wirkender szenischer Hochaltar und die kulissenhaft ins Mittelschiff hineinragenden Seitenaltäre unterstützen die theatralische Gesamtkonzeption des Innneraumes.

Die mittelalterliche Basilika der Rottenbucher Augustinerchorherren erhielt im 18. Jahrhundert eine reiche Rokoko-Ausstattung einheimischer Künstler. Die überbordende Stuckdekoration der Wessobrunner Meister Joseph und Franz Xaver Schmuzer, ein vielteiliger Freskenzyklus von Matthäus Günther mit Szenen aus dem Leben des hl. Augustinus und der szenische Hochaltar Franz Xaver Schmädls mit einer seltenen vollplastischen Darstellung der Geburt Mariens verleihen dem Innenraum der Stiftskirche eine besonders feierliche Gesamtwirkung.
artist: Pröpste Patrizius Oswald (reg. 1700-1740) und Clemens Prasser (reg. 1740-1770)
history: Die Geschichte des ehemaligen Chorherrenstiftes Rottenbuch kann bis ins 11. Jahrhundert zurückverfolgt werden. Nach mehren Bränden und dem Einsturz des Kirchturmes entstand 1477 eine neue spätgotische Basilika mit Querhaus, die bei der Umgestaltung des Innenraums und der Neuaustattung im Rokoko-Stil ab 1737 unter der Leitung des Wessobrunner Meisters Joseph Schmuzers im Kern erhalten blieb. In Zusammenarbeit mit seinem Sohn Franz Xaver gestaltete dieser bis 1744 die reiche Stuckdekoration. Sogleich im Anschluss an die Dekorierung von Chor und Querhaus begann der berühmte Augsburger Freskant Matthäus Günther mit der Ausmalung der Kirche.
keywords: Wessobrunner Stuckatorenschule; Stuck; Rocaille; Bandlwerk; skulpturaler Altar; Deckenfresko; Theatrum Sacrum; Barockisierung

en.name: Parish Church Birth of the Virgin Mary, St. Peter and Paul, former Convent Church of Augustine Canons
description: The externally modest triple-naved late gothic Basilica with a free-standing bell tower surprisingly has a lavish Rococo style furnishing on the inside. Cheerfully designed and abundantly dense stucco extends over vaults and the high nave walls. Because the stucco was affixed in stages by the Schmuzer workshop, noticeable distinctions in style can be recognized, starting from the chancel via the nave up to the organ loft: while the foliage and strapwork décor of the chancel are still fashioned in the late Régence style, scalloped Rococo as a new ornamental motif appears in the nave. Matthäus Günther’s extensive fresco cycles with Augustinian scenes expand from west to east on the high nave walls. The circular painting in the crossing of Augustine in heavenly glory replaces a customary Baroque cupola. The parts of the fresco coming out of the framework connect the painting with the stucco works of the vault. With this they resemble frescoes by Cosmas Damian Asam, of whom Günther was a pupil. Franz Xaver Schmädl’s grandiose scenographic main altar and the projecting stage-like side altars in the central nave support the overall theatrical concept of the interior.

The mediaeval Basilica of the Rottenbuch Augustine Canons received a luxurious Rococo furnishing in the 18th century by local artists. Exuberant stucco decorations of the Wessobrunn master craftsmen Joseph and Franz Xaver Schmuzer, a multipartite fresco cycle with scenes from the life of St. Augustine by Matthäus Günther and the scenographic main altar with a rare three dimensional representation of the birth of the Virgin Mary by Franz Xaver Schmädl, give the interior of the convent church an especially solemn effect.
artist: Provosts Patrizius Oswald (gov. 1700–40) and Clemens Prasser (gov. 1740–70)
history: The history of the former Augustinian Convent Church of Rottenbuch can be traced back to the 11th century. After many fires and the collapse of the church tower, a new late gothic Basilica emerged with a transept that remained unchanged in essence after the remodelling of the interior and the refurnishing in Rococo style beginning in  1737 under the direction of Wessobrunn master builder and stucco worker, Joseph Schmuzer. In collaboration with his son, Franz Xaver, Joseph Schmuzer crafted the lavish stucco decorations up to 1744. Immediately following the adorning of the chancel and transept, the famous Augsburg frescoer, Matthäus Günther, began painting throughout the church.
partner: University of Munich, Institute of Art History

en.name: *Souls in Purgatory*
description: The dynamic contour lines and the sharp edges stress the drama of the scene: souls in the flames of purgatory, and hovering above them, the redemptive figure of an angel.

en.name: London-Baghdad in 8 Days by Simplon-Orient-Express & Taurus-Express
description: Travel poster depicting the Arch of Ctesiphon (Taq Kasra) and advertising the passenger train route connecting London to Baghdad, operated by the "Compagnie Internationale des Wagons-Lits" (International Sleeping-Car Company). The journey combined two rail routes: the Simplon Orient Express from London to Istanbul, and the Taurus Express from Istanbul to Aleppo and Baghdad. Until 1935, the Syrian section terminated at Tel Kotchek, from where motor vehicles transferred passengers to Kirkuk; the final leg to Baghdad was by metre-gauge railway. The poster was issued by the French Paris-Lyon-Méditerranée (PLM) railway company and designed by French illustrator Roger Broders (1883–1953), best known for his Art Deco travel posters commissioned by the PLM, characterised by simple lines and bold, flat areas of colour.
tags: Tourism -- Middle East -- 20th Century. Orient Express

en.name: Santa Maria (Parish Church)
description:
The Parish Church of Azurara lies on the south bank of the River Ave and is larger than that of Vila do Conde, which apparently served as a model. The main vessel of the church has three aisles and five bays with simple longitudinal arcades on eight-sided pillars, covered in wood and of different heights. The east end of the church has Late Gothic ribbed vaulting, and the Royal Arms, armillary sphere, and the Cross of Christ in the chancel, confirm the patronage of D. Manuel I.  
According to an inscription, Gonçalo Lopes built the church in 1522, and was the founder of a veritable dynasty of stonemasons and master builders.  
The main door is quite simple with foliate elements in the inter-columnation and plaited pillars. The bell tower, begun at the same time, was only completed towards the end of the century.

en.name: Dust jacket; template for the edition of Heinrich Böll: *Ansichten eines Clowns*. Roman. dtv No. 400. Original drawing affixed to a pre-printed cover showing the title and publisher’s device
description: Celestino Piatti (1922–2007) was one of the best-known graphic artists in Europe in the last third of the twentieth century. From 1961 to 1992, he designed the look of the Deutscher Taschenbuch Verlag (dtv). A whole generation of readers in German-speaking Europe associates works of world literature with the covers he designed for them. Piatti read all the books whose cover he designed, and confidently translated their key scenes into memorable images. The Swiss National Museum was able to acquire from the artist’s estate over 1,000 print templates, trial proofs, and cover designs produced for dtv.
keywords: Celestino Piatti; Dust Jacket; Print Template; Heinrich Böll; Ansichten eines Clowns; Duggingen; Basel-Landschaft; Graphic Design

en.name: House of Sub-Ripas
description:
Few Manueline houses have been conserved in Coimbra, but this very fine example is one of the best in the country. Like many of the houses of the bourgeoisie or the lower nobility, it was also built on the battlement of the wall and included one of the towers. Work on the building took place soon after 1515, and the builder stamped it with the exuberant foliage, so typical of the work at Batalha. The windows and balconies are all different and strongly naturalistic in style, and the interior has largely retained the original divisions.  
Later, in Renaissance times, the Casa de Cima or Casa do Arco was built, and includes on the outer walls of both, dozens of medallions and low relief work from the workshop of Jean of Rouen, an artist whose workshop was nearby.

ar.name: ألباريلو
description: هذه  القارورة albarello هي وعاء صيدلاني مزين بشرائط زرقاء شاقولية. والزجاج الشفاف عديم اللون المضاف بعد الرسم قد تحول إلى بقع ويوجد طبقة من عرق اللؤلؤ. والتزيين بواسطة الشرائط البسيطة كان شائعا جدا خلال تلك الفترة في إيران.وبالرغم من أن القارورة لها أصول لاتينية فإن شكلها أصله من الشرق الأوسط  وقد أدخلت لأوربا في وقت ما حوالي القرن الخامس عشر. والقوارير تستخدم كقطع وظيفية وتزيينية في الصيدليات النقليدية. والجرار كانت تختم عموما بقطعة من البرشمان أو الجلد بواسطة خيط/ حبل.
dates: أواخر القرن السادس – بداية القرن السابع الهجري / أواخر القرن الثاني عشر – بداية القرن الثالث عشر الميلادي

en.name: *Albarello*
description: This *albarello*, or pharmacist vessel, is decorated with vertical blue stripes. The transparent, colourless glaze applied after painting has turned into a patchy, mother-of-pearl layer. The simple stripe decoration was very popular during the period in Iran. Although *albarello* has a Latin root, the shape originated in the Middle East and was introduced to Europe sometime around the 15th century. *Albarelli* were used as both functional and decorative objects in traditional pharmacies. The jars were generally sealed with a piece of parchment or leather tied with cord.
dates: Hegira late 6th century-early 7th century / AD late 12th-early 13th century
keywords: Albarello

ar.name: إبريق
description:
في نهاية القرن الخامس الهجري (الحادي عشر الميلادي)، جرب الخزافون المصريون مادة جديدة أحدثت ثورة في إنتاج الخزف في الشرق الأوسط: حيث قاموا بخلط كمية صغيرة من طين الفخار الأبيض التقليدي مع الكوارتز ومسحوق الزجاج ما يسمى ( فريت) وتم الحصول على جسم زجاجي صلب وأبيض كالسكر. وكان تأثير هذه التقنية هو الحصول على نوعية من السيراميك أقرب إلى الخزف الصيني. ومن مصر، وصلت المادة الجديدة إلى بلاد فارس عبر سوريا في النصف الأول من القرن السادس الهجري (الثاني عشر الميلادي) وحل محل الطين التقليدي تدريجيًا، كما كان الزجاج ذو اللون الفيروزي جديدًا أيضًا ويرتبط بمادة الكوارتز- فريت الجديدة.  
  
وسرعان ما دفعت الخصائص الجديدة لهذه المادة المبتكرة الخزافين الإيرانيين إلى تجربتها، ويشهد الإبريق الكبير ذو المقبض على هذا التدفق الإبداعي. جسمه على شكل بيضاوي ومقبضه الرفيع وفوهته التي على شكل منقار هي عناصر لا يمكن صنعها في الطين العادي. كانت الأباريق المماثلة المصنوعة من المعدن، والتي غالبًا ما تكون من النحاس أو النحاس الأصفر (خليط من النحاس و الزنك)، تستعمل بمثابة نماذج.
dates: نهاية القرن السادس-بداية القرن السابع الهجري/ نهاية القرن الثاني عشر-بداية الثالث عشر الميلادي

en.name: Jug
description:
Towards the end of the Hegira 5th (AD 11th) century, Egyptian potters tried out a new material that revolutionised ceramic production in the Middle East: they mixed a small amount of the traditional white potter’s clay with quartz and glass powder (the so-called frit) and obtained a glass-hard, sugar-white body. The effect of this technique was a quality of ceramique more akin to that of Chinese porcelain. From Egypt, the new material reached Persia via Syria in the first half of the Hegira 6th (AD 12th) century and gradually replaced the traditional clays. The turquoise-coloured glaze was also new and related to the new material quartz frit.  
  
The novel properties of this innovative material quickly led Iranian potters to experiment with it, and the large jug with a handle bears witness to this burst of creativity. Its melon-shaped body, the thin handle and the beak-shaped spout are elements that could not be made in ordinary clay. Similar jugs made of metal, often copper or brass, served as models.
dates: Hegira end or 6th-beginning of 7th century / AD end of 12th-beginning of 13th century
materials: Frit ware, decoration painted in blue and black under a transparent glaze
tags: Frit ware, decoration painted in blue and black under a transparent glaze

en.name: Ceiling Painting
description: The original ceiling painting comprising architectural elements was made by the Spanish painter Francisco Venegas at the end of the 16th century. The Triumph of the Holy Cross, among other scenes from the bible, were mostly inspired by engravings from Antwerp and added in the early 17th century by the Portuguese painter, Amaro do Vale.

pt.name: Pintura do tecto
description: A pintura original, que compreendia apenas elementos arquitectónicos, foi feita pelo pintor espanhol Francisco Venegas, nos finais do século XVI. As cenas bíblicas, inspiradas em gravuras de Antuérpia, foram acrescentadas mais tarde, durante o século XVII, nomeadamente o painel central, *O Triunfo da Santa Cruz*, atribuído ao pintor português Amaro do Vale.

ar.name: سيدة طويلة القامة واقفة على حافة بركة.
description: القطعة عبارة عن لوحة من الفريسكو تظهر في الشريط السفلي للجدار الغربي لقاعة الاستقبال في قصير عمرة الذي يصوّر ثلاثة مناظر، أوسطها اللوحة المعروضة هنا. اللوحة تمثل سيدة شبه عارية طويلة القامة تقف على حافة بركة. تحلت السيدة بأساور في ذراعها وبعقود، وغطت شعرها بغطاء شفاف في مقدمته دبوس أو مشبك. تقف السيدة وقفة استعراضية، وكأنها تحث الداخلين على النظر إليها، ويقف إلى يسارها رجل يشير بيده إليها. تقع البركة التي تقف السيدة على حافتها ضمن بناء من طابقين يظهر في الطابق العلوي منه، خلف درابزين أو حاجز قليل الارتفاع، مجموعة من الوجوه تراقب هذه السيدة. البركة المصوّرة في هذه اللوحة والبناء المحيط بها تشبه بناء البركة الذي يتقدم الساحة الأمامية في خربة المفجر. أما السيدة المصوّرة في هذه اللوحة فتذكر بإلهة الحب افروديت التي ربما تكون قد ألهمت الفنان الذي نفذ هذه اللوحة.

هذه اللوحة الفسيفسائية، موجودة في قاعة استقبال قُصيِّر عمرة، وهي مُستلهمة من صور أفروديت (آلهة الحب والجمال). موقعها المركزي، وحجمها، وهيأتها، توحي بأنها كانت شخصية ذات شأن، ربما هي الجارية المُفضَّلة عند وليِّ الأمر.
dates: النصف الأول من القرن 2 ﻫ/ 8 م.
keywords: خربة المفجر؛ رسومات جدارية؛ قاعة استقبال.

en.name: Fresco panel: ‘Tall Standing Woman at the Edge of a Pool’.
description:
A fresco on the central section of the lower register in the audience hall at Qusayr ‘Amra that depicts a remarkably tall woman standing at the edge of a pool. She is naked except for a loin cloth and is decked with wristlets, armlets, and a necklace with pendants around her neck; another, longer necklace with three pear-shaped pendants hangs between her rounded breasts. Her right arm is lowered, slightly bent towards her right thigh, while the index and little finger of her right hand are extended; the left arm is raised and bent towards her shoulder as if pulling back a curtain behind her. A turban covers her hair with a circular pin at the front.  
  
This female bather puts on a really bold display, evidently much admired by the crowd of figures watching from behind a balustrade in the left arcade. Behind her to the right is a gesturing attendant. In the background is an impressive architectural vista: a two-storey arcade with a curtain and balustrades, which may well represent pool architecture similar to that of the palace forecourt at Khirbet al-Mafjar in Jericho. The central position of the tall, semi-naked woman, her size and her attitude all indicate that she must have been an important personage, perhaps the favourite concubine of the patron of Qusayr ‘Amra.  
  
This bathing beauty brings to mind images of the Goddess of love, Aphrodite, whose image may have served as a source of inscription for this panel.

This fresco is in the audience hall at Qusayr ‘Amra and is inspired by images of Aphrodite. Her central position, size and attitude indicate that she was an important personage, perhaps a favourite concubine of the patron.
dates: Hegira first third of the 2nd century / AD second third of the 8th century.
keywords: Audience hall; bath; fresco.

es.name: Fresco de figura femenina al borde de un estanque
description:
Fresco ubicado en la parte central de la zona inferior de la sala de audiencias de Qusayr Amra, que representa a una mujer particularmente alta de pie junto a un estanque. La figura no viste nada de ropa excepto un pareo; sin embargo, lleva pulseras, brazaletes y un collar con colgantes alrededor del cuello; también lleva otro collar más largo, con tres colgantes en forma de pera, que pende entre sus pechos redondeados. Tiene el brazo derecho bajado, ligeramente doblado hacia el muslo, y los dedos índice y meñique de esa mano extendidos. El brazo izquierdo está alzado y doblado hacia el hombro, como si estuviera tirando de una cortina situada detrás de ella. Tiene el cabello cubierto por un turbante con un alfiler circular en la parte frontal.  
La actitud de esta bañista es verdaderamente atrevida, lo que explica la atenta mirada del grupo de figuras que la observan desde una balaustrada situada en la arcada de la izquierda. Detrás de la mujer, a su derecha, se ve a un observador gesticulando. El fondo está compuesto por una vista arquitectónica sensacional: una arcada de dos niveles, con balaustradas y una cortina, que recuerda a la disposición de los baños del antepatio del palacio de Jirbat al-Mafyar (Jericó). La posición central de esta mujer alta y semidesnuda, así como su tamaño y su pose, indican que debió de ser un personaje importante, quizá la concubina favorita de quien mandó construir Qusayr Amra.  
Esta hermosa mujer bañándose recuerda imágenes de Afrodita, la diosa del amor, que tal vez fueran una fuente de inspiración para este fresco.

Este fresco del salón de audiencias de Qusayr Amra se inspiró en imágenes de Afrodita. La posición central y el tamaño y la actitud de la figura indican que fue un personaje importante, tal vez la concubina predilecta del patrocinador.
holder: En su emplazamiento original, Qusayr Amra.
dates: Primer tercio del siglo II de la Hégira / primera mitad del siglo VIII d. C.
keywords: Sala de audiencias; baño; fresco.

fr.name: Panneau de fresque, “Grande Figure féminine au bord d’un bassin”.
description:
Fresque de la partie centrale sous la voûte de la salle d'audience de Qousayr Amra représentant une femme étonnamment grande, debout au bord d'un bassin. Nue, à l'exception d'un pagne, elle porte des bracelets de poignets et de bras, un collier à pendants autour du cou et un autre plus long à trois pendants piriformes qui se glisse entre ses seins ronds. Son bras droit baissé est légèrement tourné vers sa cuisse droite tandis que l'index et le petit doigt de sa main droite sont dressés. Le bras gauche est levé, penché vers l'épaule comme si elle tirait un rideau derrière elle. Ses cheveux sont recouverts d'un turban fixé sur le devant par une épingle.  
Cette baigneuse à la fière attitude est à l'évidence très admirée par les personnages qui la regardent de derrière une balustrade dans l'arcade de gauche. Derrière elle, à droite, s'affaire une servante. Dans le fond apparaît un panorama architectural impressionnant : arcade sur deux niveaux avec rideaux et balustrades, peut-être une représentation d'une architecture de bassin semblable à celle de l'avant-cour du palais de Khirbat al-Mafjar à Jéricho. La position centrale de la figure principale, sa taille et son attitude indiquent qu'elle était sans doute un important personnage, peut-être la concubine favorite du seigneur de Qousayr Amra. Cette beauté évoque des images d'Aphrodite, déesse de l'amour, qui ont pu servir d'inspiration à ce panneau.

Ce panneau de fresque se trouve dans la salle d’audience à Qousayr Amra et est inspiré des images d’Aphrodite. La position centrale de la femme, sa taille et son attitude indiquent qu’elle était sans doute un important personnage, peut-être la concubine favorite du seigneur.
dates: Premier tiers du IIe siècle de l’Hégire (première moitié du VIIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: salle d’audience ; fresques ; musique

en.name: The Black Obelisk of Assyrian King Shalmaneser III
short_description: The Black Obelisk of Assyrian King Shalmaneser III was excavated by a British expedition at Nimrud (Iraq) in 1846. There was great excitement when it was found to contain reference to Biblical king Jehu. Furthermore, it depicted his image, still the oldest image of a king of Israel.

en.name: Deutsches Soldaten u. Eisenbahnerheim in Eski-Chehir. Das Heim wurde 1916 eröffnet. (The Home of German Soldiers and Railway workers. The home was opened in 1916.
description: The Home of German Soldiers and Railwaymen (Deutsches Soldaten und Eisenbahnerheim) in Eskişehir opened in 1916. This institution served German military personnel and railway employees during the First World War. The building reflects the sizeable German railway community that had developed around Eskişehir after the town became an important junction of the German-backed Anatolian railway network. The Ottoman Anatolian Railway Company had already established a German Railway School beside Eskişehir station, operating since 1898 for the children of European railway officials and workers.
keywords: Eskişehir; railway workers; Anatolian Railway; First World War; German-Ottoman relations

en.name: Stopper
description: As well as the history of Austrian glassmaking was established in the 19th century, there was one movement that gradually paved the way for a different perception of glassmaking, and its customers, and that was Biedermeier. Known for being a decorative art favoured by the middle class, this style was witness to a great revival of glassmaking in Bohemia where new kinds of glass were being produced for a new kind of clientele. This period is characterised by a particular glass cutting technique, and it was used to create these new, marvelous pieces. This unique stopper, as an essential element of a bottle, is made of clear glass with white, polished, cut and opaque overlay. This piece, along with its bottle, is the ideal visual for understanding the great achievements of Biedermeier glasswork and how its vibrant shapes and colours filled the tables and rooms of Germanic Europe in the beginning of the 19th century.
partner: MAK – Austrian Museum of Applied Arts / Contemporary Art

The Alexandria Stock Market became a landmark in the city that frequently appears on postcards.

ar.name: آنية من تافيرا.
description:
آنية من الطين المشوي الأحمر مودع في متحف تافيرا. تتباعد جوانبه الداخلية التي تميل قليلاً نحو الخارج عن القمة، مشكلة قناة مخفيّة تسمح بمرور الماء الذي يُدخل مسبقاً فيما يشبه القمع أو عمق الزجاجة، وينفصل بشكل واضح عن بقية أجزاء الإناء. فبعد أن يسيل الماء على القناة الأنبوبية، تقوم بقذفه إلى داخل الإناء ثمانية من الأشكال الـ 14 المركّبة على الحواف.  
يحيط فارسان مدججان بالسلاح يرافقهما رامي سهام يمتطي حصاناً بفارسة؛ ويَسير وراءهم موسيقيان كانا يشكلان جزءاً من رباعي فُقدت بعض قطعه. تُتبع هذه المجموعة من الشخصيات بخمسة حيوانات بقي منها أربعة: بقرة وغزالة أو ظبية، وخروف وأسد. ووضعت مجموعة من الحَمَامات على القمع الذي يشكل عنق الإناء.  
  
من المؤكد أن هذه القطعة المدهشة من الفن الشعبي تمثل احتفال الخطيفة الذي يسبق احتفالات الزفاف حيث تشكل الحيوانات تشخيصاً مجازياً للفأل الحسن بالنسبة للعروسين. وقد كان الماء الذي تقذفه أعناق الإناء الثمانية يهدف لري شجيرة مزروعة في داخل الإناء مثل الريحان، وهو نبات يرتبط بعبادة الحب في التقاليد الإيبيرية أو المتوسطية.

تمثل هذه المزهرية التي تشكل نموذجا من الفن الشعبي احتفال الخطيفة الذي يسبق حفلة الزواج. أرفقت الشخصيات البشرية (المرأة، والجندي المسلح بقذافة والفرسان والعازفون) بحيوانات تعتبر فألا حسنا للشابين العروسين؛ وربما كان الإناء يحوي شجرة.
dynasty: الفترة المرابطية، نهاية القرن 5 أو بداية القرن 6 الهجريين / نهاية القرن 11 - بداية القرن 12 الميلاديين

en.name: The Tavira Vase.
description: Vessel made from red clay.The sides, sloping slightly outwards, become thicker at the top to form an invisible channel through which water could pass after having been poured into a kind of funnel-neck which stands out clearly from the overall piece. The water would run through the channel and then be poured into the interior of the vase through eight of the 14 figurines standing around its edge.Two armed and mounted knights, accompanied by a dismounted archer, stand on either side of a woman also on horseback. Then come two musicians, who would have been part of a quartet, now incomplete. This set of human figures was followed by five animals, four of which remain: a bovine, a camel, a deer or gazelle, another camel and a lion. A flock of doves is perched on the funnel-neck.This is an extraordinary piece of popular art probably representing the ceremonial abduction that took place before a wedding ceremony, in which the animals are intended to be an allegory of good fortune for the couple. The water coming from the eight gargoyles would be for a shrub planted in the vase, possibly basil as this plant was associated with the cult of love in Iberian and Mediterranean traditions.

This pot, an example of popular art, represents the ceremonial abduction enacted before a wedding ceremony. The human figures (woman, crossbowman, knights and musicians) are accompanied by animals, intended as a good omen for the newly weds. The pot would have contained a plant.
dates: Hegira end of 5th or beginning of 6th century / AD end of 11th or beginning of 12th century.
keywords: vase; Tavira; ceramic; firing in an oxidising atmosphere; wheel; modelled; popular art; wedding; marriage
materials: Ceramic fired in oxidising atmosphere, made on the wheel and modelled.
tags: Ceramic fired in oxidising atmosphere, made on the wheel and modelled.

es.name: Vaso (maceta) de Tavira.
description:
Recipiente de barro rojo y paredes levemente curvadas hacia el exterior y más gruesas en su parte superior, donde forman un canal invisible por el que circulaba el agua introducida por una especie de cuello o embudo que destaca claramente. El agua, después de recorrer el conducto, caía al interior de la maceta por 8 de las 14 figurillas que se alzan sobre el borde.  
Componen las figuras dos caballeros armados acompañados de un ballestero, que flanquean a una mujer también a caballo. Siguen dos músicos que formarían parte de un cuarteto hoy incompleto. A este conjunto de personajes les suceden cinco animales, de los cuales quedan cuatro: un bóvido, una corza o gacela, un camello y un león. En el cuello-embudo está posada una bandada de palomas.  
Ésta extraordinaria pieza de arte popular representa sin duda el rapto ritual que antecedía a la ceremonia del matrimonio; los animales serían una alegoría de buenos augurios para los novios. El agua vertida por las 8 gárgolas tendría por finalidad regar la planta de la maceta, quizá albahaca, relacionada con el culto al amor en las tradiciones ibéricas y mediterráneas.

Maceta de arte popular (almorávide) que representa el rapto ritual que antecedía una ceremonia de matrimonio. Las figuras humanas (mujer, ballestero, caballeros, músicos) están acompañadas de animales, que serían una alegoría de buenos augurios para los novios.
dates: Finales del siglo V o principios del VI de la Hégira / finales siglo XI o principios del  XII d. C.
keywords: cerámica roja; arte popular; ceremonia del matrimonio.
materials: Cerámica torneada y modelada, cocida en atmósfera oxidante.
tags: Cerámica torneada y modelada, cocida en atmósfera oxidante.

fr.name: Vase de Tavira.
description:
Récipient en terre cuite rouge déposé au musée de Tavira.  
Les parois, légèrement inclinées vers l'extérieur, s'évasent sur le sommet formant un canal invisible qui permet le passage de l'eau, préalablement introduite dans une sorte de goulot-entonnoir se détachant nettement de l'ensemble. L'eau, après avoir coulé sur le tubage, était à son tour propulsée vers l'intérieur du vase par 8 des 14 figurines montées sur le bord.  
Deux chevaliers armés, accompagnés d'un arbalétrier à cheval, entourent une cavalière. Les suivent deux musiciens qui devaient faire partie d'un quatuor, aujourd'hui incomplet. Cet ensemble de personnages est suivi de cinq bêtes, dont subsistent quatre : un bovidé, une biche ou gazelle, un mouton et un lion. Une bande de pigeons est posée sur le goulot-entonnoir.  
Cette étonnante pièce d'art populaire représente sûrement l'enlèvement cérémoniel qui précède une cérémonie nuptiale où les animaux constituent une allégorie de bons augures pour les mariés. L'eau propulsée par les 8 goulots était destinée à arroser un arbuste planté à l'intérieur du vase, par exemple du basilic, une plante liée au culte de l'amour dans les traditions ibériques et méditerranéennes.

Ce vase, un exemple d'art populaire, représente l'enlèvement cérémoniel qui précède une cérémonie nuptiale. Les personnages humains (la femme, l'arbalétrier, les chevaliers et les musiciens) sont accompagnés par des animaux, considérés comme de bon augure pour les jeunes mariés. Le pot a dû contenir une plante.
dates: Fin du Ve siècle ou début du VIe siècle de l’Hégire (fin XIe siècle-début XIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: vase ; Tavira ; terre cuite rouge ; cuisson oxydante ; tour ; moulé ; art populaire ; cérémonie nuptiale
materials: Terre cuite en cuisson oxydante, fabriquée et moulée au tour.
tags: Terre cuite en cuisson oxydante, fabriquée et moulée au tour.

pt.name: Vaso de Tavira.
description:
Trata-se de um recipiente de barro vermelho depositado no museu de Tavira.  
  
As paredes, levemente inclinadas para o exterior, engrossam no topo formando um canal invisível que permitia a passagem de água, previamente introduzida numa espécie de gargalo-funil que se destaca claramente do conjunto. A água, depois de percorrer a tubagem seria, por sua vez, lançada para o interior do vaso por 8 das 14 figurinhas erguidas sobre o bordo.  
  
Dois cavaleiros armados, acompanhados por um besteiro apeado, enquadram uma mulher também a cavalo. Seguem-se dois músicos que fariam parte de um quarteto, hoje incompleto. A este conjunto de personagens sucediam-se cinco animais, dos quais restam quatro: um bovídeo; uma corça ou gazela; um camelo e ainda um leão. Um bando de pombas pousa no gargalo-funil.  
  
É uma peça extraordinária de arte popular representando certamente o rapto cerimonial que antecede uma cerimónia de casamento em que os animais pretendem ser uma alegoria de bons augúrios para os noivos. A água lançada pelas 8 gárgulas teria por objectivo regar um arbusto plantado no interior do vaso e que poderia ser um mangericão, relacionado nas tradições ibéricas e mediterrâneas, ao culto do amor.

Vaso de arte popular (almorávida) representando o rapto cerimonial que antecede uma cerimónia de casamento. As figuras humanas (mulher, besteiro, cavaleiros, músicos) são acompanhadas por animais, que pretendem ser uma alegoria de bons augúrios para os noivos. Uma planta ocuparia o interior do vaso.
dates: Finais do século V ou inícios do século VI AH / finais séc. XI-inícios séc. XII AD.
keywords: vaso; Tavira; cerâmica vermelha; cozedura oxidante; torno; modelado; arte popular; cerimónia de casamento
materials: Cerâmica em cozedura oxidante, fabricado ao torno e modelado.
tags: Cerâmica em cozedura oxidante, fabricado ao torno e modelado.

en.name: Armorial carpet
description:
Inspired by Ottoman Anatolian carpets, this 17th century Spanish armorial pile carpet has a typical Oriental carpet’s layout with a large centre field and a wide arabesque border, both symmetrically laid out. The centre is dominated by a Spanish coat of arms (quarterly, first and fourth: Gules, fleur-d-lys Or; second and third: Or lion rampant Argent impaled with Gules three castles Or) crowned by a feathered helmet. Two pairs of blue lizard-like creatures with large eyes and yellow spots are positioned on the yellow field, a pair above and a pair below the coat of arms. In the four corners of the centre-field are quarter arabesque medallions. A large red carnation is positioned at each end of the centre-field and between the quarter medallions. These carnations are rendered in the Ottoman fashion for illustrating carnations on textiles. The boarder is filled with a series of yellow and red Chinese clouds alternating with white rosettes.  
  
At least two carpet-history sources name the place of manufacture for this type of Spanish carpet as being the city of Cuenca in east-central Spain. This city was well known for its Moorish carpet weavers. The ones holding coats of arms were usually made to mark the marriages of the nobility. Further research is needed to determine the identity of the coat of arms on this armorial carpet. Some have suggested that it is the coat of arms of Castile and Leon, but this has not been proven.
place: Spain; possibly the city of Cuenca
keywords: heraldry; coat of arms; Spanish carpet; animal motifs; Ottoman influence; Turkish influence; armorial carpet; lizard; castle; fleur-d-lys; carnation; cloud pattern
materials: Cotton warp and weft; wool pile

en.name: Maqam of Nabi Salih
description:
The Qur’an mentions the Prophet Salih nine times; it was he who was sent by God to guide the people of Thamud, and so nine shrines were built to honour him in different places throughout Palestine, the largest and most famous of which is the one in Ramallah. The shrine stands on the ruins of a Byzantine church to the south-east of the village. The church’s apse can still be seen close to the shrine’s western wall. This indicates the site has been visited since the Byzantine period. Even though the building is not dated, it probably belongs to the either the Mamluk or Ottoman periods. The remains of the old village, and the lodgings of the visitors and hermits, are scattered throughout the peripheral area.  
Interestingly, the shrine has remained intact. It consists of a rectangular building; a simple *mihrab* is found in the centre of the southern wall. Close to the prayer room is another large room where the caretaker and visitors to the shrine stayed. A door leading to the cenotaph is situated on the west wall; while to the west of this shrine lays a huge square. Here, the annual folk and religious festival takes place; offerings are made, food is presented to the visitors, candles are lit on the cenotaph and successive prayers are made.  
Visitors are cheered and welcomed by the villagers who all belong to the Tamimi family (originating from Hebron) and are descendants of Tamim Ibn ‘Aws al-Dari, the famous companion of the Prophet Muhammad. His descendants are also found in Jerusalem, Nablus and the Ramallah area.

es.name: MAQAM NABI SALIH
description:
El Corán menciona nueve veces al profeta Salih, que fue el enviado de Dios para guiar a los habitantes de Tamud por la buena senda. En Palestina, para honrar a este profeta se construyeron nueve *maqam*s que se encuentran dispersos por todo el país. El más grande y famoso es el de Ramallah. Situado en el extremo sureste del pueblo, está construido sobre los restos de una iglesia bizantina, cuyo ábside todavía puede contemplarse junto al muro oeste, lo que demuestra que ya desde aquella época el lugar era muy frecuentado. Aunque el edificio no está datado, es probable que se remonte a las épocas mameluca u otomana. En sus alrededores se encuentran dispersos los restos del pueblo antiguo y las habitaciones que ocupaban los *muyawir*s o visitantes.  
Sin embargo, el *maqam* se ha conservado intacto. El edificio es rectangular y en el centro del muro sur hay un sencillo *mihrab*. Junto a la sala de oración se encuentra una estancia amplia, en la que residían el custodio del lugar y los visitantes. En el muro oeste hay una pequeña puerta que conduce al mausoleo, y en el lado oeste del edificio aparece un gran patio preparado para las fiestas populares anuales. Estas celebraciones religiosas y populares consisten en ofrendas en cumplimiento de promesas y la preparación de mesas con comida para los visitantes; también se encienden velas en el cenotafio y se rezan diversas oraciones.  
Los visitantes son calurosamente recibidos por los habitantes del pueblo, que pertenecen todos a la familia Tamimi (originaria de Hebrón), descendientes de Tamim Ibn ‘Aws al-Dari, famoso compañero del Profeta Muhammad, cuya descendencia se instaló también en Jerusalén, Nablus y en la región de Ramallah.

fr.name: MAQAM NABI SALIH
description:
Le Coran mentionne neuf fois le prophète Salih, qui fut l’envoyé de Dieu pour guider les habitants de Thamud sur la bonne voie. C’est pourquoi neuf *maqams* furent élevés en son honneur dans toute la Palestine. Celui de Ramallah est le plus grand et le plus célèbre. Le *maqam* s’élève sur les ruines d’une église byzantine au sud-est du village. L’abside de l’église peut toujours être vue à côté du mur occidental du *maqam*, ce qui atteste que le site est visité au moins depuis la période byzantine. Même s’il n’est pas daté, le bâtiment remonte probablement à la période mamelouke ou ottomane. Disséminés alentour se trouvent les vestiges du vieux village et des chambres des visiteurs ou des *mujawirs*.  
Par chance, le *maqam*, lui, est demeuré intact. De forme rectangulaire, il présente un modeste *mihrab* au centre du mur méridional. À côté de la salle de prière se trouve une vaste pièce qui servait de logement au gardien du lieu et aux visiteurs. Le mur occidental est percé d’une petite porte conduisant au mausolée, tandis que dans la partie ouest du bâtiment, un vaste espace a été aménagé pour les festivités populaires et religieuses annuelles. On y fait des offrandes, on y dresse des tables pour les visiteurs, on y allume des cierges sur le cénotaphe et l’on y accomplit les différentes prières.  
Les visiteurs sont chaleureusement accueillis par les habitants du village, qui appartiennent tous à la famille Tamimi (originaire d’Hébron) – de la lignée de Tamim Ibn ‘Aws al-Dari, le célèbre compagnon du prophète Muhammad, dont la descendance s’est aussi installée à Jérusalem, Naplouse et dans la région de Ramallah.

cs.name: *Sv. Jan Nepomucký*
description:
Jedním z hlavních patronů Moravy se na přelomu 17. a 18. století stal český světec Jan Nepomucký. Generální vikář pražského arcibiskupa Jana z Jenštejna zemřel násilnou smrtí r. 1393. Kult tohoto světce se rozšířil nejen v českých zemích, ale po celé katolické Evropě a pronikl až do zámoří. Úcta k němu byla rozšířena již před jeho kanonizací – svatořečením v Římě r. 1729. Dodnes se setkáváme s poutními místy, obrazy a sochami, stavěnými na jeho počest na mnoha místech Moravy.  
Dietrichštejnský dvorní sochař Ignác Lengelacher se svatojánské tematice věnoval velmi často během celé své tvorby na Moravě, počínaje světcovou figurou na sloupu Nejsvětější Trojice v Mikulově (1723–34) a sochou světce  
v Pouzdřanech konče (1751). Po skladebné stránce má tento námět  
v Lengelacherově tvorbě řadu variant, které svědčí o jeho bohaté představivosti a vynalézavosti v opakovaném podání téže světecké postavy. Stojící sochy  
sv. Jana Lengelacher někdy doplňoval v komposiční a obsahový celek s andílčími postavami přidržujícími atributy, jindy zpodobil samotnou postavu světce buď stojící nebo klečící.  
Na představené řezbě se Lengelacher soustředil především na interpretaci duševního stavu světce adorujícího kříž, který, jak poloha rukou svědčí, původně držel v tichém, do sebe koncentrovaném meditativním rozpoložení. Obsahovou vážnost podtrhuje přísná důraznost jednoduché tělesné skladby sochy. Oblačná podstava vytváří figuře kompoziční základnu a zároveň naznačuje spojení  
s transcendentnem, neboť jde o apotheosu mučedníka.  
Po r. 1750 Lengelacher odešel d Bavorska a pak do badenského Bruchsalu, kde vstoupil do služeb štýrského biskupa, r. 1758 je doložen jako dvorní sochař uměnímilovného osvícenského markraběte Karla Friedricha z Badenu (+1811), sídlícího v Karlsruhe. Na jeho dvoře pobýval i Voltaire, Lavater nebo Goethe.

Jan Nepomucký se stal na přelomu 17. a 18. století jedním z významných patronů Moravy, jehož kult se rozšířil po celé katolické Evropě a pronikl až do zámoří. Dodnes se setkáváme s poutními místy, obrazy a sochami, stavěnými na jeho počest na mnoha místech Moravy.
keywords: Sv. Jan Nepomucký

en.name: *St. John of Nepomuk*
description:
The Czech martyr John of Nepomuk became one of the major Moravian saints at the turn of the 17th century. The general vicar of the Archbishop of Prague was murdered in 1393. As a saint, his cult spread all over the Czech lands and Roman Catholic Europe and even overseas. John of Nepomuk was worshipped even before his canonisation and beatification in Rome in 1729. Today, one still encounters pilgrimage sites, pictures and statues erected in his honour in many places in Moravia.  
Ignaz Lengelacher, sculptor to the Dietrichstein family, frequently devoted himself to St. John of Nepomuk as a subject for his work in Moravia, from the saint's figure on the Holy Trinity Column in Mikulov (1723–34) to his statue in Pouzdřany (1751).  
In terms of composition, the subject appears in Lengelacher's oeuvre in a number of versions, manifesting the artist's fertile imagination and the inventiveness of his approaches to a single saint. St. John is alone in Lengelacher's statues, standing or kneeling, or sometimes accompanied by the standing figures of angels holding characteristic attributes.  
Lengelacher paid particular attention to interpretation of the saint's mental state in the adoration of the cross which, as shown by the position of hands, he had initially been clasping in quiet, self-absorbed contemplation. The seriousness of the subject is accentuated by the strict emphasis placed on the plain physique of the statue. The cloud pedestal provides the figure with a compositional base and indicates a connection with the transcendent, as the figure is an apotheosis of a martyr, a patron saint of the Czech lands.  
After 1750, Lengelacher left for Bavaria and then went to Bruchsal in the Baden region, where he entered the service of the Bishop of Styria. In 1758 he is recorded as the sculptor to the enlightened and art-loving Margrave Karl Friedrich of Baden (c. 1811) in Karlsruhe, whose court also hosted, among others, Voltaire, Lavater and Goethe.

John of Nepomuk became one of major Moravian saints at the turn of the 17th century. His cult spread all over Catholic Europe and even reached overseas. Today one still encounters pilgrimage sites, pictures and statues erected in his honour in many places in Moravia.

en.name: *Aladdin, or The Magnificent Lamp: sketch of the set for act 1 or act 2*
short_description: The tale of Aladdin and his lamp was very popular in the theatre and the opera following the rise of Orientalism in the 1820s. Its first performance as an opera in 1822 was so successful that gas was used for the first time ever at the Opéra de Paris, to light up the lamp on stage.
keywords: Opera; Orientalism

fr.name: *Aladin ou La lampe merveilleuse : esquisse de décor de l'acte I ou acte II*
short_description: L'histoire d'Aladin connaît une grande vogue à l'opéra et au théâtre dès les années 1820, lors de la mode orientaliste. La première représentation de cet opéra en 1822 rencontre un succès d'autant plus grand que pour éclairer la lampe d'Aladin, on utilise pour la première fois le gaz à l'Opéra de Paris.
keywords: Opéra; orientalisme

de.name: ehem. Benediktinerabtei St. Mang
names: Kath. Stadtpfarrkirche St. Mang sowie Rathaus bzw. Stadtmuseum
description: Herkomers durch die beengte Hanglage zwangsweise verschachtelter und in der Höhe gestaffelter Klosterbau überrascht mit originellen Einfällen, darunter die als Ovalrotunde angelegte Bibliothek, die über eine Rundöffnung mit dem darunterliegenden Refektorium korrespondiert. Den stadtseitigen großen Hof beherrscht der von einem Schweifgiebel bekrönte Festsaalbau. Mit einer kostbaren Marmorausstattung prunkt die zugleich als Stadtpfarrkirche dienende Abteikirche, die baulich als Import venezianischer Baukunst gelten darf: Die heimische Wandpfeilerbauweise liefert zwar die Raumstruktur, doch ist diese gestaltprägend mit Elementen oberitalienischer Benediktinerabteikirchen kombiniert, indem das kuppelige Gewölbesystem S. Giustina in Padua und die Chorlösung und Vierungskuppel S. Giorgio Maggiore in Venedig verpflichtet sind. Ins Venezianische verweisen außerdem Einzelmotive wie beispielsweise die Thermenfenster.

Das dem Apostel des Allgäus geweihte Benediktinerkloster, situiert in pittoresker Hanglage am Rand der Füssener Altstadt zwischen Lechufer und Hohem Schloß, ist als Ableger venezianischer Sakralbaukunst eine Rarität. Als gebürtiger Allgäuer verstand es sein universal ausgebildeter Schöpfer Johann Jakob Herkommer, heimische Bau- und Kunsttraditionen mit oberitalienischen Erfahrungen zu verbinden. Hervorzuheben sind die marmorne Altarausstattung der Kirche, ein Gemälde des Venezianers Giovanni Antonio Pellegrini sowie der von dem Stuckateur Andrea Maini gestaltete prunkvolle Festsaal.
artist: Äbte Gerhard Oberleitner (reg. 1696-1714) und Dominikus Dierling (reg. 1714-1738)
history: Die Keimzelle der um 850 gegründeten Benediktinerabtei bildet ein vom St. Gallener Mönch Magnus um 730 errichtetes Gotteshaus, das dessen Begräbnisstätte wurde und nach erfolgter Heiligsprechung zum Pilgerziel avancierte. Mit der Grundsteinlegung vom 10. Mai 1701 begann die vollständige, geschickt mittelalterliche Fundamente nutzende barocke Erneuerung des Klosters. Die bauliche und künstlerische Leitung übertrug man dem unweit von Füssen geborenen und im Veneto einschließlich Venedig geschulten Universalkünstler Johann Jakob Herkomer, der bis zu seinem Tod im Weihejahr 1717 sein Werk baulich vollenden konnte und in Chor und Querhaus der Kirche auch die Stuck- und Freskendekoration begonnen hatte. Sein Neffe Johann Georg Fischer vollendete die Kirche stilgemäß, unter anderem mit eigenen Altarentwürfen, während die Gestaltung des Festsaals dem Tessiner Stuckateur Andrea Maini übertragen wurde.
keywords: Kloster; Refektorium; Abteikirche; Stuck; Mönchschor; Festsaal; Thermenfenster

en.name: Benedictine Abbey of St. Mang/Magnus
names: Catholic Parish Church of St. Mang and Town Hall/Town Museum
description: Herkomer's monastery – inevitably tiered and intricate, due to its narrow hillside location – surprises with original ideas, specifically the library. Created as an oval rotunda, it corresponds, through an oculus, with the refectory beneath. The ceremonial hall is crowned with a scrolled gable and dominates the large courtyard facing the town. Also used for parish service, the abbey church flaunts its precious marble and rightfully qualifies as an import of Venetian architecture. The local tradition of wall pillar construction creates the layout, but is formatively combined with elements of Benedictine churches which can be found in the Venetian realm: the domed vaults refer to Santa Giustina in Padua, whereas the choir and the crossing are linked to San Giorgio Maggiore in Venice. Another reference to Venetian models are single motifs such as the so-called Diocletian windows, an antique window type deriving from Roman baths which had been popular in Venice since Andrea Palladio.

Dedicated to the so-called Allgovian apostle, the Benedictine abbey resides on a scenic slope at the edge of the old town of Füssen, between the Lech's riverside and the castle named "Hohes Schloss", and is a rarity as an offshoot of Venetian ecclesiastical architecture. As a native to the Allgäu region, its versatilely-trained builder, Johann Jakob Herkomer, competently combined local traditions of art and architecture with his expertise achieved in Northern Italy. Particular mention should be made of the church's furnishing with marble altars, two altarpieces painted by the Venetian artist Giovanni Antonio Pellegrini and the splendid ceremonial hall decorated by stuccoer Andrea Maini.
artist: Abbots Gerhard Oberleitner (gov. 1696–1714) and Dominikus Dierling (gov. 1714–38)
history: Founded around 850, the Benedictine abbey originated from a church that was built around 730 by the St. Gallen monk, Magnus of Füssen, whose final resting place lies in this very location. After his canonisation, the place of worship evolved into a destination for an increased number of pilgrimages. A Baroque renovation of the monastery was initiated by the cornerstone ceremony on 10 May 1701, which skilfully incorporated the medieval foundations of the structure. The construction and artistic management were assigned to Johann Jakob Herkomer, a universal artist born near Füssen, who had been trained in the Region of Veneto, including Venice. Before his death in 1717 – the year of the consecration – he was able to complete the structural work and started implementing the stucco and fresco decoration in the choir and the transept of the church. Maintaining Herkomer's style, his nephew, Johann Georg Fischer, finalised the church, including designs for the altars, while the task of decorating the ceremonial hall was given to the Ticino stuccoer, Andrea Maini.
partner: University of Munich, Institute of Art History

ar.name: سجادة.
description:
تعتبر هذه القطعة نموذجاً بارزاً من السجاد القوني، وتعَد واحدة من أقدم أصناف السجاد التركي في الأناضول. اللحمة والسداة مصنوعتان من الصوف، والتقنية المستخدمة في الحياكة هي ”الحبكة التركية المزدوجة“ التي تعرَف باسم حبكة جيردس. أما الألوان المستخدمة فهي الأحمر والأزرق الداكن والأزرق ولون الصوف الطبيعي. يشتمل القسم الرئيسي من السجادة على نمط هندسي ذي شكل خطاف متكرر باللون الأحمر، منسوج على خلفية حمراء فاتحة. مواضيع المثلثات والمثمنات والزوايا المترادفة وأشكال الخطاطيف مستوحاة من طابع التشكيل الهندسي المتكرر في السجاد السلجوقي. يغلب على البنية الزخرفية عنصر ”اللاتناهي“ بوصفه نموذجاً نمطياً في السجاد التركي. تتكرر الرسوم بشكل متواصل، ويفصل ما بين الأشكال المتكررة نقاط زرق تبرز تغايراً شديداً مع الخلفية الحمراء.  
  
تحيط بالقسم الرئيسي من السجادة حاشية ضيقة مكوَّنة من نجمات ثمانية الرؤوس ذات لون أزرق داكن يفصل بينها خطوط بيجية ضاربة إلى الصفرة. أما المعلم الأبرز في السجادة فهو الحاشية العريضة المزينة بخط كوفي زائف يتكون من أحرف كوفية واضحة، ذات لون أزرق فاتح، تتبع بعضها بعضاً فوق خلفية زرقاء داكنة. ويفصل بين هذه الأحرف شرائط حمراء مؤطرة بلون بيج. إن هذه الحواشي الموشَّاة بخط كوفي بارز تعتبر من خصائص السجاد السلجوقي.  
  
يُستكمل التشكيل الزخرفي للسجادة بحاشية خارجية ضيقة مزينة بأشكال نجمية ثمانية الرؤوس ملونة بالأحمر فوق خلفية زرقاء. السجادة بالية تماماً، وقد زال معظم الزئبر عنها، وضاعت أجزاء من حوافها الخارجية، وثمة تمزق كبير في وسطها.  
  
كان السجاد السلجوقي يُنسَج بأبعاد كبيرة، ويُزخرف بتشكيلات هندسية بسيطة تتكون من عدد قليل من الألوان ذات الأطياف المتنوعة تحدث تناقضاً مرغوباً مع الحاشية العريضة المزينة بالخط الكوفي.  
  
وُجدت هذه السجادة في مسجد علاء الدين في قونية، وهي واحدة من ثماني سجادات سلجوقية أحضرت إلى المتحف وسُجلت في قائمة الموجودات بتاريخ 30 ربيع الأول 1329 / 31 آذار (مارس) 1911.

هذا هو أقدم أمثلة "البساط القونيوي" المعروفة. إن بُسُط هذه الفترة مُتميِّزة بالمزاوجة بين الضوء والظلّ، بالرسوم الهندسية المُتكرِّرة على الأرضية التي ترمز إلى مبدأ اللانهاية، وبحواشي عريضة مُزيَّنة بنقوش زخرفية بالخطّ الكوفي، وقد كانت مُحاكة وفقاً لتقنيات عقدة "غوردس" التركية المزدوجة.
keywords: حبكة تركية مزدوجة؛ جيردس؛ سجادة.

en.name: Rug.
description:
This is an outstanding example of a 'Konya rug', considered one of the earliest Turkish rug groups in Anatolia. Both warp and weft are wool. The weaving technique used is the 'Turkish double knot', known as the Gördes knot. The colours are red, dark-blue, blue, and beige. The main field of the rug has a geometric pattern with hooked red motifs on a light-red background. Triangles, octagons, hands-on-hip, and hook motifs form a repetitive geometric composition characteristic of Seljuq rugs. The decorative composition is dominated by the principle of 'infinity', as is typical with Turkish rugs. The design is repeated continuously. Between the repeating motifs are blue dots, which provide a strong contrast to the red background.  
  
The field of the rug is surrounded by a narrow border of eight-pointed, dark-blue star motifs separated from each other by yellow-beige lines. The most striking feature of the rug is the wide border decorated with pseudo-*kufic* script. Bold, stylised, *kufic* letters in light-blue follow one another on a dark-blue background. The letters are divided by red bands outlined in beige. Such monumental *kufic*\-script borders are characteristic of Seljuq rugs.  
  
The decorative composition of the rug is completed by a narrow outer border decorated with red eight-pointed star motifs on a blue background. The rug is quite worn; much of the pile is gone. Areas of the outer border are missing, and there is a large tear in the middle.  
  
Seljuq rugs commonly were woven in large dimensions and decorated with plain geometric compositions consisting of a small number of colours in various shades contrasting with a wide *kufic* border.  
  
Found in the Alaaddin ('Ala' al-Din) Mosque in Konya, this is one of eight Seljuq rugs brought to the Museum and registered in the inventory on 30 Rabi' al-Awwal 1329 / 31 March 1911.

This is the oldest known example of a 'Konya rug'. The rugs of this period are characterised by contrasting light and dark shades, repetetive geometric motifs in the ground representing the principle of infinity and a wide border with stylised *kufic* script, and were woven in Turkish (Gördes) double-knot technique.
holder: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts.
keywords: Gördes; rug; geometric patterns; pseudo inscriptions
materials: Wool on wool, woven with the Turkish double knot also known as the Gördes knot.
tags: Wool on wool, woven with the Turkish double knot also known as the Gördes knot.
partner: Museum of Turkish and Islamic Arts

es.name: Alfombra.
description:
Magnífico ejemplo de alfombra de Konya, considerado uno de los estilos de alfombra turca más antiguos de Anatolia. Tanto la urdimbre como la trama son de lana, y la técnica de tejedura empleada es el “doble nudo turco” o “nudo de Gördes”. Los colores usados son el rojo, el azul oscuro, el azul y el beige. La parte principal presenta un diseño geométrico de motivos rojos en forma de gancho sobre un fondo de color rojo claro. La composición geométrica repetitiva de la alfombra, formada por triángulos, octógonos, “brazos en jarras” y ganchos, es característica de las alfombras selyuquíes. El diseño se repite continuamente, dominado por el principio de “infinitud” típico de las alfombras turcas. La alfombra está salpicada de puntos azules, que contrastan mucho con el fondo rojo.  
La superficie de la alfombra está rodeada por un estrecho borde de estrellas de ocho puntas azul oscuro, separadas entre sí por líneas de color beis. El elemento más notable de la alfombra es el borde ancho adornado con caracteres pseudocúficos azul claro, estilizados y de trazo grueso, que se suceden sobre un fondo azul oscuro. Están divididos por bandas rojas horizontales perfiladas en color beis. Estos bordes con caracteres cúficos monumentales son típicos de las alfombras selyuquíes.  
La composición decorativa está rematada con un fino borde exterior adornado con estrellas rojas de ocho puntas sobre fondo azul. La alfombra está muy deteriorada y gran parte del pelo ha desaparecido. Se han perdido zonas del borde exterior y hay una gran desgarradura en el medio.  
Las alfombras selyuquíes solían ser de grandes dimensiones y se decoraban con esquemas geométricos sencillos tejidos con pocos colores en varios tonos, en contraste con un borde cúfico ancho.  
Esta alfombra selyuquí, hallada en la mezquita de Alaaddin de Konya, es una de las ocho que se llevaron al museo, en cuyo inventario se registraron el día 30 de *rabi al-awwal* de 1329 / 31 de marzo de 1911.

Ejemplo más antiguo conocido de “alfombra de Konya”, caracterizada por sus contrastes de tonos claros y oscuros, los fondos con motivos geométricos repetitivos que representan el infinito y el borde ancho con letras cúficas. Se tejían con la técnica del doble nudo turco o nudo de Gördes.
holder: Museo de Arte Turco e Islámico.
dates: Siglo VII de la Hégira / XIII d. C.
keywords: Gördes; alfombra.
materials: Lana sobre lana, tejida con la técnica del doble nudo turco, también conocido como “nudo de Gördes”.
tags: Lana sobre lana, tejida con la técnica del doble nudo turco, también conocido como “nudo de Gördes”.
partner: Museo de Artes Turcas e Islámicas

fr.name: Tapis.
description:
Remarquable exemple de “tapis de Konya”, considéré comme l'un des plus anciens styles de tapis d'Anatolie. La trame et le poil sont en laine. La technique utilisée est celle du “double-nœud turc” également appelé point noué *ghiordès*, du nom de la petite ville de Gördes (région de Manisa). Les couleurs sont le rouge, le bleu foncé, le bleu et le beige. Le champ principal présente une construction géométrique à motifs rouges crochus sur fond rouge clair. Des motifs de triangles, d'octogones, de “mains sur les hanches” et de crochets forment une composition géométrique répétitive caractéristique des tapis seldjoukides. La décoration est dominée par le principe d'“infinité”, typique des tapis turcs. Entre les motifs répliqués en continu, des points bleus forment un puissant contraste avec le fond rouge.  
Le tapis s'achève par une étroite bordure à motifs d'étoiles à huit branches de couleur bleu foncé séparées par de fines lignes beiges. L'élément le plus frappant est la large bordure à écriture pseudo-coufique stylisée en bleu clair sur fond bleu foncé. Les lettres sont interrompues horizontalement par des bandes rouges à contours beiges. Ce type de bordure en coufique est caractéristique des tapis seldjoukides.  
Le tapis est assez usé et l'essentiel de son velours a disparu. Certaines zones de la bordure extérieure ont disparu et une grande déchirure marque la partie centrale.  
Les tapis seldjoukides étaient généralement de grandes dimensions et décorés de compositions géométriques simples faisant appel à un nombre réduit de couleurs de diverses nuances contrastant avec une importante bordure d'écriture coufique.  
Trouvé dans la mosquée d'Alaadin \[Ala' al-Din\] à Konya, ce tapis est l'un des huit remis au musée et enregistrés dans son inventaire le 30 *rabi' al-Awwal* 1329 H / 31 mars 1911 J.-C.

Voici le plus vieil exemple de “tapis de Konya”. Les tapis de cette période sont caractérisés par le contraste entre les couleurs claires et les couleurs foncées, les motifs géométriques répétitifs du fond, allégoriques de la notion d’Infini, une large bordure à écriture pseudo-coufique stylisée et un tissage selon la technique du double-nœud turc ou nœud de Ghiordès.
holder: Musée des arts turcs et islamiques.
dates: VIIe siècle de l’Hégire (XIIIe siècle J.-C.).
keywords: double nœud turc ; ghiordès ; tapis
materials: Laine sur trame de laine, tissée au “point noué ghiordès” ou “double nœud turc.”

tr.name: Halı.
description:
Anadolu'da Türk halı sanatının en erken örneklerinden olan "Konya Halıları" grubunun seçkin bir örneğidir. Atkı, çözgü iplikleri yüne yündür. Dokumada Gördes düğümü kullanılmıştır. Halının bütününde kırmızı, lacivert, mavi, krem renkler kullanılmıştır. Halının ana zemininde açık kırmızı üzerine koyu kırmızı renkte, uçları kancalı çengel motiflerden oluşan geometrik bir düzenleme görülür. Kaydırılmış eksenlerde sıralanan üçgen, sekizgenler, elibelinde ve eğri çengel motiflerinden oluşan geometrik desenler Selçuk halıları için karakteristiktir. Süsleme kompozisyonunda Türk halılarına özgü "sonsuzluk" anlayışı hakimdir. Desen sürekli tekrarlanarak devam etmektedir. Birbirini tekrarlayan motiflerin ortasında mavi noktalar yer alır. Bunlar açık-koyu kırmızı zeminde uyumlu bir renk kontrastı oluştururlar.  
  
Ana zemin kompozisyonunu araları sarı çizgilerle ayrılmış sekiz köşeli lacivert yıldızların sıralandığı ince bir bordür kuşatır. Halının asıl çarpıcı olan kufi yazıya benzer desenlerle bezeli geniş bordürüdür. Koyu mavi zemin üzerine stilize iri kufi harfleri sırt sırta sıralanmışlardır. Sarı (krem) konturlu enine kırmızı şeritlerle bölümlenmiş harfler açık mavi renklidir. Halıya anıtsal bir görüntü kazandıran kufi yazılı bordür aynı zamanda Selçuklu halılarının karakteristik özelliğidir.  
  
Halının desen kompozisyonu mavi renkli bölmeler içinde kırmızı renkli, sekiz köşeli yıldızların sıralandığı ince dış bordürle tamamlanır. Oldukça yıpranmış halıda dış bordür ancak iki uzun kenarda seçilebilmektedir. Kufi hatlı geniş bordürün dış kenarını mavi çizgilerle bölümlenmiş kareler içinde kırmızı sekiz köşeli yıldızların sıralandığı ince dış bordür kuşatır. Halının havları büyük ölçüde dökülmüştür. Dış bordürleri yer yer eksik ve orta zeminde büyük bir yırtık vardır.  
  
Genellikle büyük boyutlu dokunan Selçuklu halıları, çok az rengin açıklı koyulu tonlarının kullanımıyla geometrik bir düzende sade bir desen şemasına karşılık kufi yazı istifli geniş bordürleriyle anıtsal bir görünüme sahiptirler.

Konya halılarının bilinen en erken tarihli örneğidir. Açık-koyu renklerin kontrast oluşturması, ana zeminde sonsuzluk prensibiyle tekrarlanan geometrik motiflerin kullanılması ve stilize iri kufi yazılı geniş bordürlerin görüldüğü bu dönem halıları, Türk (Gördes) düğüm tekniğinde dokunmuşlardır.
keywords: Gördes; Türk düğümü- Çift düğüm; halı
materials: Yüne yün dokuma; Düğüm: Gördes düğümü

de.name: Stift St. Florian und Stiftsbasilika
names: Stift und Stiftsbasilika der Augustiner-Chorherren von St. Florian
description:
Nach dem Ende der Kriege gegen das Osmanische Reich beauftragten die Augustiner Chorherren einen Architekten mit dem Bau einer neuen Kirche auf dem Platz eines früheren Gotteshauses. Als nächstes wurde, daran anschließend, der enorm lange Westflügel errichtet. Ein anderer Architekt, der das repräsentative Stiegenhaus leicht änderte und fertigstellte, fügte auch das mächtige Portal bei, das sich über drei Stockwerke erstreckt.  
Der Südflügel mit dem pavillonartig herausgestellten Marmorsaal gilt als das Wahrzeichen von St. Florian. Der Hof wurde mit dem Bau des Ostflügels geschlossen, in dessen Mitte sich die Bibliothek befindet. Es gibt noch einen anderen, kaum zu sehenden Trakt, der im Nordosten des Stiftsgebäudes herausragt, das Sommer-Refektorium, das ein geplantes, nicht ausgeführtes Projekt erahnen lässt. Es sollte ein Zwillingsgebäude (ein Theater) gegenüber und einen anschließenden weitläufigen französischen Garten erhalten.

Wie etliche Menschen dieser Epoche liebten es auch die fünf im Barock lebenden Prälaten und Pröpste, neue Gebäude zu errichten. 1686 bauten sie eine neue Kirche, wobei romanische und gotische Wände eines früheren Baus miteinbezogen wurden, und zu Beginn des 18. Jahrhunderts neue Stiftsflügel. Es brauchte 65 Jahre und drei Architekten, um das Ensemble fertigzustellen. So kann man an Stift St. Florian besonders gut erkennen, wie sich barocke Kunst und Architektur innerhalb von beinahe sieben Jahrzehnten entwickelten.

history:
Unter Römischer Herrschaft bekannte sich (der spätere heilige) Florian(us) öffentlich zum Christentum, wurde deswegen gefoltert und gefesselt in den Fluss Enns geworfen, wo er starb. Vermutlich wurde er unter der Stiftskirche begraben, woraufhin St. Florian bald als Platz über dem Grab des Heiligen bekannt wurde.  
Das Stift wurde vermutlich von Bewohnern der Gegend gegründet und nicht wie viele andere Abteien von einem Fürsten oder einem Aristokraten. Die Augustiner Chorherren erwarben im Laufe der Jahrhunderte eigenen Besitz und eigenes Vermögen und konnten während der Barockära neue Gebäude errichten. Unter Kaiser Joseph II mussten sie Enteignung und Verluste hinnehmen, wovon sich Stift St. Florian glücklicherweise erholen konnte. Es ist bis heute für seine prachtvolle barocke Architektur bekannt.

en.name: St. Florian Abbey and Abbey Basilica
names: Augustinian Canons´ Abbey and Abbey Basilica in St. Florian
description:
After the end of the Wars Against the Ottoman Empire the Augustinian Canons commissioned an architect to erect a new church on the place of an earlier one. Next, the enormously long west wing was built. Another architect who slightly changed and finished the representative staircase added the magnificent portal extending over the three floors.  
The south wing with the pavilionlike Marble Hall became St. Florian´s landmark. The court was completed by adding the east wing with the Library in its centre. There is another, almost unseen wing, protruding from the abbey building in the Northeast, the Summer Refectory. It bespeaks an unexecuted scenic project that would have been completed with a twin building opposite (a theatre) and a spacious connecting French garden.

Like most people of this era, the five Baroque prelates and provosts loved building. They started to erect a new church in 1686, re-using Romanesque and Gothic walls from an earlier building, and new monastery wings at the beginning of the 18th century. It took 65 years and three architects to complete the ensemble. So St. Florian abbey has become a very good example to understand how Baroque art and architecture developed within two thirds of a century.

history:
Under Roman rule, (the later saint) Florian(us) confessed being Christian, and was therefore tortured and thrown bound into the river Enns where he died. He was probably buried somewhere under the abbey church; for that reason St. Florian soon became known as “place above the saint´s grave”.  
The monastery was probably founded by nearby residents and not like many other abbeys by a prince or by a nobleman. Nevertheless, the Augustinian Canons acquired property and made profits over the centuries and erected new buildings during the Baroque era. Under Emperor Joseph II they had to put up with expropriation and loss. Anyway, St. Florian has economically recovered and is still known for its magnificent Baroque architecture.

en.name: The Istanbul Main Post Office
short_description: The Istanbul Main Post Office is an office building for postal services located at Sirkeci quarter of Fatih district in Istanbul, Turkey. It was designed by architect Vedat Tek in First Turkish National architectural style and was constructed between 1903 and 1909. The four-story building houses a post office, the Sirkeci Post Office, office space for regional administration and also since 2000 the Istanbul Postal Museum. It is Turkey's largest post office building.

en.name: Temacine
description:
Temacine was a medieval village built in a beautiful oasis south of Touggourt.  
  
The big *sebkha*, or swamp, called Chemora extends to the centre of the oasis of Temacin. A beautiful mosque was built on a base of palm logs. The minaret of the mosque is square and built of fine terracotta bricks that form geometric designs comparable to those found in Tozeur, Tunisia. According to local tradition, the mosque would have been contemporary with that of Touggourt. Similar designs can be found on the facades of wealthy homes, and evoke motifs of carpets from the region.  
  
The minaret is very high: it is necessary to climb 100 steps to reach the top. The traveler el-Aiachi claimed that the minaret was built in 817 / 1414 by an architect from Fez called Ahmed ben Mohammed, who came to Ghir Wadi on a pilgrimage. Indeed, on the door of the mosque you can read: “architect Ahmed bin Mohammed el-Fassi, built in the year 817 \[of the Hegira\]”.

fr.name: Temacine
description:
Temacine est un village médiéval au sud de Touggourt, construit en toub dans une belle oasis.  
  
La grande *sebkha* ou marais de Touggourt appelée Chemora s’étend jusqu’au centre de l’oasis de Temacine. Une belle mosquée fut bâtie sur un socle de rondins de palmiers. Le minaret de la mosquée est de plan carré et construit en fines briques de terre cuite formant des motifs géométriques comparables à ceux que l’on rencontre à Tozeur en Tunisie. D’après la tradition locale, il serait contemporain de celui de Touggourt. Ses motifs se retrouvent sur les façades des demeures fortunées et évoquent ceux des tapis de la région. Le minaret est très haut : il faut escalader cent marches pour arriver au sommet. Le voyageur el-Aïachi a affirmé que le minaret avait été construit en 817/1414 par un architecte de Fès appelé Ahmed ben Mohammed et qui serait venu en pèlerinage dans l’oued Ghir. Et en effet, sur la porte de la mosquée, on peut lire : “architecte Ahmed ben Mohammed el-Fassi, construite en l’an 817 \[de l’Hégire\]”.

en.name: Madrasa of Taghri Bardi
description:
The *madrasa* was built in 844/1440 by Amir Taghri Bardi, also known by the name of *al-mu’di* (the harmful) for his bad temper. He held a high position under Sultan Barsbay and became a general in the army that conquered Cyprus in 830/1426. Later, under Sultan Jaqmaq, he was named *dawadar* (Secretary of State), one of the seven most important posts in government.  
Despite its apparently small surface area, the building contains a *madrasa*, mausoleum, *sabil* and *kuttab*. The façade on al-Saliba Street bears evidence of the building’s internal layout. The main entrance in the centre of the wall is flanked to the right by the wall of the *madrasa* and to the left by the *sabil* and *kuttab*.  
The decoration above the main entrance is organised on three levels. A traditional tri-lobed arch, the vault of which is filled with *muqarnas* decoration, crowns the doorway. The first level contains the lintel and the relieving arch which together present an *ablaq* formation of *voussoirs* known as *al-‘ara’is* (the dolls) and thought to be a new stage in the development of this kind of arch. Triangular pieces of marble fit together and the interlocking edges are cut in the shape of abstract leaves resembling that of a doll. The second row is a simple *ablaq* composition with a small barred window in its centre, while the third is divided into three squares. The central square is ornamented with *muqarnas* and the two sides with leaf motifs, crowned with a *naskhi* inscription. The entrance is framed by a rectangular border rising above the cornice, in a similar fashion to that of the Mosque of al-Mu’ayyad Shaykh (II.1.i).  
The mausoleum annexed to the *madrasa* is covered by a lengthened dome, the outer surface of which displays geometric figures in relief. The vertical nature of the pattern makes it appear disproportionately long.  
The minaret has three sections, square-based, circular and *gawsaq*, separated by balconies supported on *muqarnas* rows and crowned with a by-then traditional bulbiform finial. The second section of the shaft testifies to the new stage in minaret decoration; it bears an eightpointed-star lattice on its upper half.

es.name: Madrasa de Tagri Bardi
description:
La *madrasa* fue construida en 844/1440 por el emir Tagri Bardi, apodado *al-Mu’di* (el nocivo) por su mal carácter. Ocupaba un alto cargo en la época del sultán Barsbay; fue general del ejército que conquistó Chipre en 830/1426. Después, con el sultán Yaqmaq, fue nombrado *dawadar* (secretario de Estado), uno de los siete cargos más importantes del gobierno.  
Aunque de superficie reducida, este edificio contiene una *madrasa*, un mausoleo, un *sabil* y un *kuttab*. La fachada principal, que da a la calle al-Saliba, refleja la organización interior de esta obra; en el centro, el acceso monumental está flanqueado a la derecha por la fachada correspondiente a la *madrasa*, y a la izquierda por el *sabil* y el *kuttab*.  
La decoración del acceso, coronado por el típico arco trilobulado relleno de mocárabes, se organiza en tres órdenes que se superponen a la puerta. En la primera fila, el dintel y el arco de descarga presentan un ensamblaje *ablaq* de dovelas, llamado *al-‘ara’is* (las muñecas) en el dintel, que se considera una nueva etapa en la evolución de la decoración de este tipo de arcos. Consiste en el trabado de piezas de mármol triangulares, cuyos cortes en forma de hojas abstractas recuerdan a un muñeco. La segunda es una sencilla composición *ablaq*, con una pequeña ventana enrejada en el centro, mientras la tercera está dividida en tres cuadrados; el central adornado con mocárabes, y los laterales decorados con motivos vegetales, coronados por una inscripción *nasji*. El conjunto del acceso está resaltado por un marco rectangular que se eleva sobre la cornisa, de la misma manera que en la mezquita de al-Mu’ayyad Chayj (II.1.i).  
El mausoleo, anejo a la *madrasa*, está cubierto por una cúpula alargada, con el exterior decorado en relieve con figuras geométricas, cuya verticalidad acentúa su altura.  
El alminar consta de tres fustes separados por balcones, sostenidos por mocárabes, y que pasan de la planta cuadrada a la circular y al *gawsaq* coronado con el ya típico remate bulbiforme. El segundo fuste representa una nueva etapa en la decoración de los alminares: una lacería de ocho que rodea la mitad superior del cuerpo.

fr.name: Madrasa de Taghri Bardi
description:
La *madrasa* fut construite en 844/1440 par l’émir Taghri Bardi, surnommé *al-mu’di* (le nocif) en raison de son mauvais caractère. Il occupait une charge éminente à l’époque du sultan Barsbay; il fut général de l’armée qui conquit Chypre en 830/1426. Plus tard, sous le sultan Jaqmaq, il fut nommé *dawadar* (secrétaire d’État), un des postes les plus importants du gouvernement.  
Bien que de superficie réduite, cet édifice contient une *madrasa*, un mausolée, un *sabil* et un *kuttab*. La façade principale, qui donne sur la rue al-Saliba, reflète l’organisation intérieure du bâtiment; au centre, l’accès monumental est flanqué à droite par la façade correspondant à la *madrasa*, et à gauche par le *sabil* et le *kuttab*.  
La décoration de l’entrée, couronnée par le typique arc trilobé meublé de *mouqarnas*, s’organise en trois ordres qui se superposent à la porte. Dans la première rangée, le linteau et l’arc de décharge présentent un assemblage *ablaq* de voussoirs – appelé *al-‘ara*’is (les poupées) sur le linteau – qui est considéré comme une nouvelle étape dans l’évolution de la décoration de ce type d’arcs: un assemblage de pièces de marbre triangulaires qui, par leur découpe en forme de feuilles abstraites, évoquent des silhouettes de marionnettes. La deuxième rangée est une simple composition *ablaq*, avec une petite fenêtre grillagée au centre, tandis que la troisième est divisée en trois carrés; celui du centre est orné de *mouqarnas*; les deux carrés latéraux présentent une décoration à base de motifs végétaux, couronnés par une inscription *naskhide*. L’ensemble de l’accès est accentué par un encadrement rectangulaire qui s’élève au-dessus de la corniche, de la même façon que dans la mosquée de al-Mu‘ayyad Cheikh.  
Le mausolée annexé à la *madrasa* est couvert d’une coupole surhaussée, dont la partie extérieure est décorée de figures géométriques en relief dont la verticalité accentue la superbe.  
Le minaret comporte trois fûts séparés par des balcons soutenus par des *mouqarnas*, et qui passent du plan carré au plan circulaire et au *gawsaq* coiffé du déjà typique couronnement bulbiforme. Le deuxième fût représente une nouvelle étape dans la décoration des minarets: un entrelacs de huit qui cerne la moitié supérieure du corps.

en.name: Lajvardina bowl
description: At the turn of the 13th and 14th centuries a new type of luxurious enamel-painted ceramics called '*lajvardina*" emerged in Ilkhanid Iran. The Persian word "*lajvard*" means "lapis lazuli", which pointed in this case to the specific deep blue colour of the vessel background provided by cobalt-based glaze. The bowl, presumably made in Kashan, presents an impressive sample of this showy and costly technique. The polychromous decor of floral motifs arranged overglaze in a cross pattern is supplemented by the elements of gold foil. The hemispherical shape of the bowl reveals artistic influence of Yuan porcelain ware of China.
keywords: Ceramics; Iran; Kashan

de.name: Kath. Pfarrkirche St. Nikolaus
description: Die Pfarrkirche von Elbigenalp folgt dem einfachen Pfarrkirchen-Schema mit Saal-Langhaus und eingezogenem Chor. Die Ausrundung der östlichen Langhausecken und der kräftig geschwungene Chorbogen bereichern den Chorprospekt. Die Deckenfresken und die Seitenaltäre, daneben auch die Kanzel (um 1770), die aus der Pfarrkirche Mayrhofen im Zillertal stammt, verleihen dem Raum eine prachtvolle Gesamtwirkung, die von außen kaum zu erahnen ist.

Der von außen unauffällige, auch im Inneren architektonisch recht schlichte Saalbau ist für seine in lichter Farbigkeit gemalten Deckenfresken berühmt, Spätwerke Johann Jakob Zeillers aus Reutte. Durch den ebenfalls gemalten Stuck, der die Freskenfelder rahmt, hat der Maler hier ein einheitliches spätbarockes Dekorationssystem geschaffen, das der Kirche Festsaalcharakter verleiht.
artist:

Bildhauer (Seitenaltäre): Maximilian Hitzelsberger (1743-1780)

history: Der ursprüngliche Kirchenbau wurde wohl um 1300 errichtet, die Urpfarre Lechtal ist erstmals im Jahre 1312 beurkundet. Eine Vergrößerung erfolgte im 15. Jahrhundert, eine weitere mit Umbau 1661-74 (Weihe 1685) und schließlich 1774, als die flache Holzdecke durch ein Gewölbe ersetzt worden ist. Dieses wurde von Johann Jakob Zeiller bis 1776 (signiert und datiert) ausgemalt. Aus dieser Zeit stammt auch die meiste weitere Ausstattung.

en.name: Catholic Parish Church of St. Nicholas
description: The parish church of Elbigenalp is built according to the simple parish church scheme of a hall nave and retracted choir. The rounding of the eastern nave corners and boldly curved choir arches enrich the prospect of the choir. The ceiling frescos and side altars, as well as the pulpit (c. 1770) which originates from the parish church of Mayrhofen in Zillertal, lend the space a magnificent overall impression, hardly to be suspected from the outside.

The outwardly unimposing hall building, whose interior architecture is also decidedly plain, is famous for its ceiling frescos painted in lucid colours, late works of Johann Jakob Zeiller from Reutte. Thanks to the stucco framing of the fresco panels, also painted, the artist succeeded in creating a uniform Late Baroque system of decoration which lends the church the character of a festive hall.
dates: 1661–1674: Baroque modification; c. 1770–1776: Rococo interior work
artist: Master builder, modification: Georg Falger (1661–1674); sculptor of side altars: Maximilian Hitzelsberger (1743–1780); ceiling frescos: Johann Jakob Zeiller (1708–1783)
history: The original church building was erected in around 1300, and the ancient parish of Lechtal is first documented in 1312. The church was enlarged in the 15th century and once again between 1661 and 1674 together with a modification (consecration 1685) and finally in 1774 when the flat wooden ceiling was replaced by a vault. This was painted by Johann Jakob Zeiller and completed in 1776 (signed and dated). The majority of the additional interior work also originates from this period.
